run.input_snapshot: Parameter snapshot identical to model-library green-hydrogen-lcoh-v1 run 2026-11-18, no changes: CAPEX tiers 950/1200/1500 CNY/kW (CEEC 2025 centralised procurement etc., compiled layer); SEC tiers 50/52/56 kWh/kg (system AC; Sungrow Hydrogen 4.60-4.65 kWh/Nm3 etc., compiled layer); discount rate 6/8/10% (judgement); life 15/20/25 years (judgement); fixed O&M 2/3/4% of CAPEX per year (judgement); water use 9/10/15 kg/kg; purified water 4/6/8 CNY/t (judgement). Electricity-price matrix tiers 0.15/0.25/0.35 CNY/kWh (scenario settings, anchors in the model-library run record); the price DB holds no first-party electrolyser / green-power price series yet for re-basing; source gap registered
run.assumptions: Mid tier as baseline is an analytical judgement; stack replacement is not modelled explicitly (a replacement reserve is inside the O&M rate); boundary is inside the hydrogen-production plant fence, excluding civil works, off-site power lines, hydrogen storage/compression and transport/refuelling; the full-calibre grid price (Mengxi two-part 0.4355 CNY/kWh) sits above the matrix top tier, so pure grid-power LCOH should be read as at least ~22 CNY/kg; the 6,000 h tier is in tension with wind/solar direct-supply operating patterns
